visualCharacteristics.purpose: retailer locator search panel beside a buy-online CTA panel
visualCharacteristics.description: Two fixed side-by-side panels: Where To Buy retailer search (Nearby link, address search, distance radios) and Buy Online with CTA

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells; cell 1 = H2 + link to /retailers (block renders address search + distance options), cell 2 = H2 + CTA link
contentPattern.notes: Any column containing a link to /retailers becomes the search panel; the form submits GET to that path with searchAddress and distance.
